scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node api.js && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta -k "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: node api.js && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client exec tsc -- --noEmit
